prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Meet Your Future Desktop Companion", "Explore unique pet personalities and select your ideal companion.", "Choose Companion Trait"]
1: ["Desktop Pet Quick Controls", "Learn how to easily summon, move, hide, or chat with your pet anywhere on your screen.", "Alt + P: Show/Hide Pet", "Got It"]
2: ["Sign in to save your pet securely to your cloud account so your progress is never lost across sessions."]
3: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "Configuring 3D model, desktop physics, and AI interactions..."]
4: []
5: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Give your companion a name to complete the adoption process."]
6: ["Interactive Desktop Tour", "Try moving your companion to your favorite spot on the screen!", "Start Playing"]
7: ["Enable desktop notification so you can safely use other apps while your pet generates."]
8: ["How Would You Like to Adopt?", "Choose Instant Adoption (1 min) or Custom AI Pet Creation (3 mins).", "Continue"]
9: ["Founding Companion Parent"]

verdicts.problem: Tricks or misleads the user into enabling notifications by claiming it is needed to safely use other apps.
